name: Duke Nukem 3D
long_description: Duke Nukem 3D, running the DukeNano3D port of Chocolate Duke3D as a flash-resident engine core. One package, one engine: the blob is executed from the app partition through the instruction cache, so a Duke-sized engine needs no executable RAM. Includes the compacted shareware episode (E1L1-4) in the app; the engine reads it through the core's file callbacks, so nothing is written to storage. The game is GPL v2 or later and the Build engine is under the Build license; sources are at github.com/MicroPythonOS/MicroPythonOS (c_mpos/duke3d) and github.com/DukeNano3D. Touch controls: left half walks and turns, right half is X/Y, A/B and START/MENU. On this development image the engine is flashed into the reserved retro-core partition; the app also works with the engine file in its folder. The engine runs on a task of its own, so the OS keeps its MicroPython stack and the game gets the 48 KiB it needs; requires a firmware with mpos_core ABI 9 (see c_mpos/duke3d/README.md).
